verses.ar: «وَمَتَى أَتَتْ عَلَيْكَ كُلُّ هَذِهِ ٱلْأُمُورِ، ٱلْبَرَكَةُ وَٱللَّعْنَةُ، ٱللَّتَانِ جَعَلْتُهُمَا قُدَّامَكَ، فَإِنْ رَدَدْتَ فِي قَلْبِكَ بَيْنَ جَمِيعِ ٱلْأُمَمِ ٱلَّذِينَ طَرَدَكَ ٱلرَّبُّ إِلَهُكَ إِلَيْهِمْ،
verses.kjv: And it shall come to pass, when all these things are come upon thee, the blessing and the curse, which I have set before thee, and thou shalt call [them] to mind among all the nations, whither the LORD thy God hath driven thee,
verses.web: It shall happen, when all these things have come on you, the blessing and the curse, which I have set before you, and you shall call them to mind among all the nations where Yahweh your God has driven you,

verses.ar: وَرَجَعْتَ إِلَى ٱلرَّبِّ إِلَهِكَ، وَسَمِعْتَ لِصَوْتِهِ حَسَبَ كُلِّ مَا أَنَا أُوصِيكَ بِهِ ٱلْيَوْمَ، أَنْتَ وَبَنُوكَ، بِكُلِّ قَلْبِكَ وَبِكُلِّ نَفْسِكَ،
verses.kjv: And shalt return unto the LORD thy God, and shalt obey his voice according to all that I command thee this day, thou and thy children, with all thine heart, and with all thy soul;
verses.web: and return to Yahweh your God and obey his voice according to all that I command you today, you and your children, with all your heart and with all your soul,

verses.ar: يَرُدُّ ٱلرَّبُّ إِلَهُكَ سَبْيَكَ وَيَرْحَمُكَ، وَيَعُودُ فَيَجْمَعُكَ مِنْ جَمِيعِ ٱلشُّعُوبِ ٱلَّذِينَ بَدَّدَكَ إِلَيْهِمِ ٱلرَّبُّ إِلَهُكَ.
verses.kjv: That then the LORD thy God will turn thy captivity, and have compassion upon thee, and will return and gather thee from all the nations, whither the LORD thy God hath scattered thee.
verses.web: that then Yahweh your God will release you from captivity, have compassion on you, and will return and gather you from all the peoples where Yahweh your God has scattered you.

verses.ar: إِنْ يَكُنْ قَدْ بَدَّدَكَ إِلَى أَقْصَاءِ ٱلسَّمَاوَاتِ، فَمِنْ هُنَاكَ يَجْمَعُكَ ٱلرَّبُّ إِلَهُكَ، وَمِنْ هُنَاكَ يَأْخُذُكَ،
verses.kjv: If [any] of thine be driven out unto the outmost [parts] of heaven, from thence will the LORD thy God gather thee, and from thence will he fetch thee:
verses.web: If your outcasts are in the uttermost parts of the heavens, from there Yahweh your God will gather you, and from there he will bring you back.

verses.ar: وَيَأْتِي بِكَ ٱلرَّبُّ إِلَهُكَ إِلَى ٱلْأَرْضِ ٱلَّتِي ٱمْتَلَكَهَا آبَاؤُكَ فَتَمْتَلِكُهَا، وَيُحْسِنُ إِلَيْكَ وَيُكَثِّرُكَ أَكْثَرَ مِنْ آبَائِكَ.
verses.kjv: And the LORD thy God will bring thee into the land which thy fathers possessed, and thou shalt possess it; and he will do thee good, and multiply thee above thy fathers.
verses.web: Yahweh your God will bring you into the land which your fathers possessed, and you will possess it. He will do you good, and increase your numbers more than your fathers.

verses.ar: وَيَخْتِنُ ٱلرَّبُّ إِلَهُكَ قَلْبَكَ وَقَلْبَ نَسْلِكَ، لِكَيْ تُحِبَّ ٱلرَّبَّ إِلَهَكَ مِنْ كُلِّ قَلْبِكَ وَمِنْ كُلِّ نَفْسِكَ لِتَحْيَا.
verses.kjv: And the LORD thy God will circumcise thine heart, and the heart of thy seed, to love the LORD thy God with all thine heart, and with all thy soul, that thou mayest live.
verses.web: Yahweh your God will circumcise your heart, and the heart of your offspring, to love Yahweh your God with all your heart and with all your soul, that you may live.

verses.ar: وَيَجْعَلُ ٱلرَّبُّ إِلَهُكَ كُلَّ هَذِهِ ٱللَّعَنَاتِ عَلَى أَعْدَائِكَ، وَعَلَى مُبْغِضِيكَ ٱلَّذِينَ طَرَدُوكَ.
verses.kjv: And the LORD thy God will put all these curses upon thine enemies, and on them that hate thee, which persecuted thee.
verses.web: Yahweh your God will put all these curses on your enemies and on those who hate you, who persecuted you.

verses.ar: وَأَمَّا أَنْتَ فَتَعُودُ تَسْمَعُ لِصَوْتِ ٱلرَّبِّ، وَتَعْمَلُ بِجَمِيعِ وَصَايَاهُ ٱلَّتِي أَنَا أُوصِيكَ بِهَا ٱلْيَوْمَ،
verses.kjv: And thou shalt return and obey the voice of the LORD, and do all his commandments which I command thee this day.
verses.web: You shall return and obey Yahweh’s voice, and do all his commandments which I command you today.

verses.ar: فَيَزِيدُكَ ٱلرَّبُّ إِلَهُكَ خَيْرًا فِي كُلِّ عَمَلِ يَدِكَ، فِي ثَمَرَةِ بَطْنِكَ وَثَمَرَةِ بَهَائِمِكَ وَثَمَرَةِ أَرْضِكَ. لِأَنَّ ٱلرَّبَّ يَرْجِعُ لِيَفْرَحَ لَكَ بِٱلْخَيْرِ كَمَا فَرِحَ لِآبَائِكَ،
verses.kjv: And the LORD thy God will make thee plenteous in every work of thine hand, in the fruit of thy body, and in the fruit of thy cattle, and in the fruit of thy land, for good: for the LORD will again rejoice over thee for good, as he rejoiced over thy fathers:
verses.web: Yahweh your God will make you prosperous in all the work of your hand, in the fruit of your body, in the fruit of your livestock, and in the fruit of your ground, for good; for Yahweh will again rejoice over you for good, as he rejoiced over your fathers,

verses.ar: إِذَا سَمِعْتَ لِصَوْتِ ٱلرَّبِّ إِلَهِكَ لِتَحْفَظَ وَصَايَاهُ وَفَرَائِضَهُ ٱلْمَكْتُوبَةَ فِي سِفْرِ ٱلشَّرِيعَةِ هَذَا. إِذَا رَجَعْتَ إِلَى ٱلرَّبِّ إِلَهِكَ بِكُلِّ قَلْبِكَ وَبِكُلِّ نَفْسِكَ.
verses.kjv: If thou shalt hearken unto the voice of the LORD thy God, to keep his commandments and his statutes which are written in this book of the law, [and] if thou turn unto the LORD thy God with all thine heart, and with all thy soul.
verses.web: if you will obey Yahweh your God’s voice, to keep his commandments and his statutes which are written in this book of the law, if you turn to Yahweh your God with all your heart and with all your soul.

verses.ar: «إِنَّ هَذِهِ ٱلْوَصِيَّةَ ٱلَّتِي أُوصِيكَ بِهَا ٱلْيَوْمَ لَيْسَتْ عَسِرَةً عَلَيْكَ وَلَا بَعِيدَةً مِنْكَ.
verses.kjv: ¶ For this commandment which I command thee this day, it [is] not hidden from thee, neither [is] it far off.
verses.web: For this commandment which I command you today is not too hard for you or too distant.

verses.ar: لَيْسَتْ هِيَ فِي ٱلسَّمَاءِ حَتَّى تَقُولَ: مَنْ يَصْعَدُ لِأَجْلِنَا إِلَى ٱلسَّمَاءِ وَيَأْخُذُهَا لَنَا وَيُسْمِعُنَا إِيَّاهَا لِنَعْمَلَ بِهَا؟
verses.kjv: It [is] not in heaven, that thou shouldest say, Who shall go up for us to heaven, and bring it unto us, that we may hear it, and do it?
verses.web: It is not in heaven, that you should say, “Who will go up for us to heaven, bring it to us, and proclaim it to us, that we may do it?”

verses.ar: وَلَا هِيَ فِي عَبْرِ ٱلْبَحْرِ حَتَّى تَقُولَ: مَنْ يَعْبُرُ لِأَجْلِنَا ٱلْبَحْرَ وَيَأْخُذُهَا لَنَا وَيُسْمِعُنَا إِيَّاهَا لِنَعْمَلَ بِهَا؟
verses.kjv: Neither [is] it beyond the sea, that thou shouldest say, Who shall go over the sea for us, and bring it unto us, that we may hear it, and do it?
verses.web: Neither is it beyond the sea, that you should say, “Who will go over the sea for us, bring it to us, and proclaim it to us, that we may do it?”

verses.ar: بَلِ ٱلْكَلِمَةُ قَرِيبَةٌ مِنْكَ جِدًّا، فِي فَمِكَ وَفِي قَلْبِكَ لِتَعْمَلَ بِهَا.
verses.kjv: But the word [is] very nigh unto thee, in thy mouth, and in thy heart, that thou mayest do it.
verses.web: But the word is very near to you, in your mouth and in your heart, that you may do it.

verses.ar: «اُنْظُرْ. قَدْ جَعَلْتُ ٱلْيَوْمَ قُدَّامَكَ ٱلْحَيَاةَ وَٱلْخَيْرَ، وَٱلْمَوْتَ وَٱلشَّرَّ،
verses.kjv: ¶ See, I have set before thee this day life and good, and death and evil;
verses.web: Behold, I have set before you today life and prosperity, and death and evil.

verses.ar: بِمَا أَنِّي أَوْصَيْتُكَ ٱلْيَوْمَ أَنْ تُحِبَّ ٱلرَّبَّ إِلَهَكَ وَتَسْلُكَ فِي طُرُقِهِ وَتَحْفَظَ وَصَايَاهُ وَفَرَائِضَهُ وَأَحْكَامَهُ لِكَيْ تَحْيَا وَتَنْمُوَ، وَيُبَارِكَكَ ٱلرَّبُّ إِلَهُكَ فِي ٱلْأَرْضِ ٱلَّتِي أَنْتَ دَاخِلٌ إِلَيْهَا لِكَيْ تَمْتَلِكَهَا.
verses.kjv: In that I command thee this day to love the LORD thy God, to walk in his ways, and to keep his commandments and his statutes and his judgments, that thou mayest live and multiply: and the LORD thy God shall bless thee in the land whither thou goest to possess it.
verses.web: For I command you today to love Yahweh your God, to walk in his ways and to keep his commandments, his statutes, and his ordinances, that you may live and multiply, and that Yahweh your God may bless you in the land where you go in to possess it.

verses.ar: فَإِنِ ٱنْصَرَفَ قَلْبُكَ وَلَمْ تَسْمَعْ، بَلْ غَوَيْتَ وَسَجَدْتَ لِآلِهَةٍ أُخْرَى وَعَبَدْتَهَا،
verses.kjv: But if thine heart turn away, so that thou wilt not hear, but shalt be drawn away, and worship other gods, and serve them;
verses.web: But if your heart turns away, and you will not hear, but are drawn away and worship other gods, and serve them,

verses.ar: فَإِنِّي أُنْبِئُكُمُ ٱلْيَوْمَ أَنَّكُمْ لَا مَحَالَةَ تَهْلِكُونَ. لَا تُطِيلُ ٱلْأَيَّامَ عَلَى ٱلْأَرْضِ ٱلَّتِي أَنْتَ عَابِرٌ ٱلْأُرْدُنَّ لِكَيْ تَدْخُلَهَا وَتَمْتَلِكَهَا.
verses.kjv: I denounce unto you this day, that ye shall surely perish, [and that] ye shall not prolong [your] days upon the land, whither thou passest over Jordan to go to possess it.
verses.web: I declare to you today that you will surely perish. You will not prolong your days in the land where you pass over the Jordan to go in to possess it.

verses.ar: أُشْهِدُ عَلَيْكُمُ ٱلْيَوْمَ ٱلسَّمَاءَ وَٱلْأَرْضَ. قَدْ جَعَلْتُ قُدَّامَكَ ٱلْحَيَاةَ وَٱلْمَوْتَ. ٱلْبَرَكَةَ وَٱللَّعْنَةَ. فَٱخْتَرِ ٱلْحَيَاةَ لِكَيْ تَحْيَا أَنْتَ وَنَسْلُكَ،
verses.kjv: I call heaven and earth to record this day against you, [that] I have set before you life and death, blessing and cursing: therefore choose life, that both thou and thy seed may live:
verses.web: I call heaven and earth to witness against you today that I have set before you life and death, the blessing and the curse. Therefore choose life, that you may live, you and your descendants,

verses.ar: إِذْ تُحِبُّ ٱلرَّبَّ إِلَهَكَ وَتَسْمَعُ لِصَوْتِهِ وَتَلْتَصِقُ بِهِ، لِأَنَّهُ هُوَ حَيَاتُكَ وَٱلَّذِي يُطِيلُ أَيَّامَكَ لِكَيْ تَسْكُنَ عَلَى ٱلْأَرْضِ ٱلَّتِي حَلَفَ ٱلرَّبُّ لِآبَائِكَ إِبْرَاهِيمَ وَإِسْحَاقَ وَيَعْقُوبَ أَنْ يُعْطِيَهُمْ إِيَّاهَا.
verses.kjv: That thou mayest love the LORD thy God, [and] that thou mayest obey his voice, and that thou mayest cleave unto him: for he [is] thy life, and the length of thy days: that thou mayest dwell in the land which the LORD sware unto thy fathers, to Abraham, to Isaac, and to Jacob, to give them.
verses.web: to love Yahweh your God, to obey his voice, and to cling to him; for he is your life, and the length of your days, that you may dwell in the land which Yahweh swore to your fathers, to Abraham, to Isaac, and to Jacob, to give them.
